title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses and stabilizes in a population under social influence, policies, enforcement, information campaigns, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence_update
interactions.description: Individuals update mask-use propensity based on the fraction of their social ties and household members wearing masks.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_location
interactions.description: Locations with mask policies verify compliance at entry and may deny entry or issue penalties.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Government and media broadcast messages affecting trust, risk perception, perceived benefits/costs; misinformation may reduce adoption.

interactions.name: mask_procurement
interactions.description: People purchase or receive masks from suppliers subject to price, inventory, and distribution limits.

interactions.name: daily_activity_contacts
interactions.description: People visit workplaces, schools, and public venues, creating opportunities for observation (social learning) and enforcement.

interactions.name: policy_adjustment
interactions.description: Government updates mandates and enforcement based on observed adoption and compliance metrics.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until the overall adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: daily_new_adopters
metrics.description: Count of individuals who start wearing masks on each day.

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Share of individuals complying with mask policies in covered locations during mandate periods.

metrics.name: post_mandate_persistence
metrics.description: Fraction of mask users who continue wearing masks after mandates end.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of denials, warnings, or fines issued at locations per day.

metrics.name: adoption_by_context
metrics.description: Mask use rates segmented by context (household, workplace/school, public venues).

metrics.name: adoption_variance_by_age
metrics.description: Variance or disparity in adoption rates across age groups.

metrics.name: mask_stockouts
metrics.description: Days or instances where suppliers have insufficient inventory to meet demand.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change magnitude below 0.1% for at least 14 consecutive days indicates steady state.

validation_criteria.name: enforcement_effect_presence
validation_criteria.description: Scenarios with high enforcement_level (>= 0.8) and venue_policy_coverage (>= 0.8) should produce higher adoption than low-enforcement scenarios, all else equal.

validation_criteria.name: supply_demand_balance_check
validation_criteria.description: Total masks acquired by people must not exceed cumulative supplier distribution minus inventory change.
